title: NASCAR Cup Series Championship in Miami: Listen Live on SiriusXM
summary: Hear every lap of this weekend’s NASCAR Cup Championship Series race from Homestead-Miami Speedway live on SiriusXM NASCAR Radio.
body_markdown:
NASCAR returns to Homestead-Miami Speedway for Championship Weekend, culminating in Sunday’s NASCAR Cup Series Championship Race — and you can hear every lap live on[SiriusXM NASCAR Radio (Ch. 90)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/siriusxm-nascar-radio) .


[SiriusXM NASCAR Radio 24/7 NASCAR talk & live races Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogCupSeriesChampionshipNascar)


The 2026 NASCAR season culminates this weekend as champions are crowned across NASCAR’s three national series. Championship Weekend returns to Homestead-Miami Speedway for the first time since 2019, with the Cup Series finale taking place Sunday, November 8.


### Cup Series Championship Race: How to Listen


Tune in to SiriusXM NASCAR Radio (Ch. 90) on car radios and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogCupSeriesChampionshipNascar) for live coverage of the NASCAR Cup Series Championship from Homestead-Miami Speedway.


**Date:** Sunday, November 8, 2026
**SiriusXM Coverage:** 12pm ET
**Race Start:** 3pm ET
**Race:** NASCAR Cup Series Championship Race
**Series:** NASCAR Cup Series
**Track:** Homestead-Miami Speedway
**SiriusXM Channel:** SiriusXM NASCAR Radio (Ch. 90)


**Listen on SiriusXM Driver Channels:**


Kyle Larson (No. 5) — Ch. 997
Denny Hamlin (No. 11) — Ch. 998
Christopher Bell (No. 20) — Ch. 999


### More NASCAR Races This Weekend on SiriusXM


In addition to Sunday’s Cup Series Championship Race, SiriusXM NASCAR Radio (Ch. 90) will carry live coverage of the NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series and NASCAR O’Reilly Auto Parts Series championship races from Homestead-Miami Speedway.


- **Friday, November 6:** NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series Championship Race — SiriusXM coverage begins at 6:30pm ET; race starts at 7:30pm ET.
- **Saturday, November 7:** NASCAR Cup Series Pole Qualifying at 2:30pm ET, followed by the NASCAR O’Reilly Auto Parts Series Championship Race — SiriusXM coverage begins at 3:30pm ET; race starts at 5pm ET.


[Learn more about SiriusXM’s exclusive NASCAR coverage.](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/nascar-cup-series)
